messages:
nina: Quick question 4 IC being promoted to senior IC and manager put in a comp-change that crosses band. what approvals do we need and any extra docs?
kevin: If crossing band: manager -> manager's manager -> People Ops director. also include previous exception memos if the person was on a temporary band.
arjun: Evidence to attach: 1) 3-5 bullet promo rationale (scope, measurable impact, systems/people affected) 2) a recent example of ownership 3) updated org chart snippet 4) HRIS employee id. Peer notes optional.
kevin: Finance needs ECD, annualized delta, and cost center/GL. If delta > $20k/yr add Sr Finance approver.
nina: Manager asked about timeline: can this land on next payroll (in 6 business days)?
payroll-bot: Automated rule: comp-change + all approvals + cost code must be received >= 4 business days before payroll close to have high confidence. Missing attachments push to next cycle.
arjun: If urgent, mark form SUBJECT with [PRIORITY] and ping @people-ops-review. People Ops will triage with Finance but no guarantees.
kevin: Retro pay? short retro (<30 days) is often approved with People Ops + Finance signoff. retro >30 days escalates to CFO. flag "retro" on the form.
nina: Anything special for international hires? manager is in EMEA.
arjun: For EMEA/intl, include local payroll code and confirm region-specific limits with Global Payroll. People Ops will route to Global Payroll and comp-ops for equity.
nina: great, thanks. i'll update the form and attach the 4 docs and tag PRIORITY.
people-ops-bot: Checklist: submit comp-change form (https://redwood-internal/forms/comp-change), attach evidence bullets, org chart, HRIS id, include cost code, mark PRIORITY if urgent. See playbook.
